doc: A Titan-like body (15.9 d): no storm track, profile exactly 0 (positive spin). 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 0 (worst of 6 random trials); no difference was observed at all.
